title: Evaluation of n-covectors at an n-family is a continuous map into n-vectors
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ there is a continuous map ev : (Fin n → ℝᴾ) → MultiVector P n (MultiVector P n = continuous linear functionals on the n-covectors Covector (Euclid P) n, with the operator-norm topology; Fin n → ℝᴾ with the product topology) such that ev(c)(α) = α(c) for every family c = (c₁, …, cₙ) and every n-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), ∃ ev : (Fin n → Euclid P) → MultiVector P n, Continuous ev ∧ ∀ (c : Fin n → Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), ev c α = α c
